title: Clicked: now what? in practice
intro: Stop the damage in the first 15 minutes. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Sign-in failed
decisions.prompt: The page shows an error. What do you do?

artifact.title: Sign-in failed
body: Wrong password. Try again or use another password.

decisions.explain: Type nothing more. Close the page and move to the next step.

decisions.title: Threat detected
decisions.prompt: Your antivirus raises an alert. What do you do?

artifact.title: Threat detected
body: A malicious macro was found in Akt_imzala.docm. Cleanup did not finish.

options.label: Turn off Wi-Fi, unplug the cable

decisions.explain: Off the network, the computer cannot spread the damage or send data out.

decisions.title: Your mailbox is 98% full
decisions.prompt: The email is still in your inbox. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: Your mailbox is 98% full
body: Increase your storage so mail is not deleted:

decisions.explain: Your report lets security remove the email from other inboxes too.

decisions.title: Message from Fərid
decisions.prompt: Did your colleague do the right thing?

artifact.name: Fərid
body: I opened a strange file. I turned off Wi-Fi and I'm calling security now.

decisions.explain: Disconnect first, then report by phone.

decisions.title: Message from Leyla
decisions.prompt: Did your colleague do the right thing?

artifact.name: Leyla
body: I opened the file, then deleted it. Nobody will know.

decisions.explain: Deleting destroys the trail, and hiding gives the attack time.
